claim: *Service-flow model.* A declared graph of which service may reach which. The public web tier is the only node facing the outside; an absent edge means the relationship is not permitted by the model, and enforcement is separate.

topology.description: Declared permitted service relationships; absence does not declare a relation.

required_terms: Each arrow declares a permitted relationship.
bw_encoding: All service and external nodes white; permitted relationships are carried by directed edges.
redesign: All service and external nodes white; permitted relationships are carried by directed edges. Two orthogonal fan-out rails; only worker feeds the specialist-service rail.
alt: The declared service graph connects Internet to web; web to worker, document editor and other; worker to generation, render and OCR. Every directed edge is a declared permitted relationship. An absent edge declares no relationship.

review.reference: current authored SVG (not older D2 receipts)
review.outcome: Modeled services gray contrasted with external Internet; exact permitted edges retained.
review.strict_compile: zero warnings, overfull boxes, missing glyphs or errors
